item.title: Trump suggests 'fear' could be key to diplomatic success in nuclear talks with Iran
item.description: Trump's comments follow dispatching a second aircraft carrier to Middle East, amid a massive US military buildup in the region.

item.title: Trump hints at Caracas visit as Washington lifts Venezuela oil sanctions
item.description: US Energy Secretary has cleared away additional sanctions that have blocked oil industry investment in South American country.

item.title: Mark Carney visits memorial as new details surface about Canada shooting
item.description: PM Carney lays flowers in remote mining town of Tumbler Ridge following killings of eight people by 18-year-old shooter.

item.title: Arundhati Roy withdraws from Berlin Film Festival in protest over Gaza genocide remarks
item.description: Globally acclaimed writer "shocked and disgusted" by responses of jury president Wim Wenders, who stated cinema should "stay out of politics" when questioned about Gaza.

item.title: Eyeing midterms, Trump threatens to bypass Congress with executive order on election reforms
item.description: US President Trump says his executive order will ensure voter identification is required for midterm elections, despite likelihood of legal challenges.

item.title: Pakistan vs India: Hottest ticket in cricket sparks T20 World Cup fever
item.description: Emotions are expected to be high as every ball and shot is cheered or jeered in this high-stakes showdown between the nuclear-armed South Asian neighbours, whose dispute over Kashmir often spills onto the field.

item.title: US Homeland Security faces shutdown as lawmakers clash over border enforcement
item.description: Democrats demand major reforms to ICE operations following fatal shootings in Minneapolis as the funding deadline approaches.

item.title: Colombia revives spraying of coca fields with drones amid renewed US cooperation
item.description: South American nation in 2015 suspended aerial spraying of glyphosate, which has been linked to cancer in humans, over concerns about its negative health impact

item.title: US ends decade-long temporary protected status for Yemenis
item.description: Homeland Security Secretary Kristi Noem says Yemen no longer meets criteria for TPS, giving beneficiaries 60 days to leave or face deportation.

item.title: Havana refinery fire under control amid deepening Cuban fuel crisis
item.description: The Caribbean nation of 9.6 million lost its main oil supply line when Trump last month ordered the abduction of Nicolas Maduro, the long-term leader of Cuban ally Venezuela.
